meaning:
ἐνέργεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐνεργής), [in LXX: Wis.7:17, 26 13:4 18:22, 2Ma.3:29, 3Ma.4:21 3Mac 5:12 3Mac 5:28 * ;]
operative power (as distinct from δύναμις, potential power), working: of God, Eph.1:19 3:7 4:16, Php.3:21, Col.1:29 2:12; of Satan, 2Th.2:9 2:11 (cf. M, Th., l.with; AR, Eph., 241 ff.; Cremer, 261).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things…
for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
